title: The Dogs Got the Buns
lines: Dad set ten buns on a pan.
Dogs! Ten dogs did get up.
The dogs got the buns. Dad is mad.
The dogs did go in the mud.
Buns in the mud! Bugs on the buns!
Dad can not get the buns.
But the pigs did get the buns.
Dad is not mad. The pigs get buns.

questions.ask: Where did the dogs take the buns?
questions.listenFor: Into the mud. It is stated in the story. If your child is unsure, point to the word mud and read that line again.

questions.ask: Who ate the buns in the end?
questions.listenFor: The pigs. Listen for pigs, not dogs - the dogs took them, the pigs finished them.

questions.ask: Do you think Dad should bake more buns? Tell me why you think so.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. You are listening for a reason - the dogs would take them again, or everybody was hungry.
